morceaux.1: Heroides III. Briseis Achilli P. OVIDI NASONIS EPISTVLAE HEROIDVM
morceaux.2:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">Quam legis, a rapta <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Briseide</name> littera venit,</l>
  <l n="2">vix bene barbarica Graeca notata manu.</l>
  <l n="3">quascumque adspicies, lacrimae fecere lituras;</l>
  <l n="4">sed tamen et lacrimae pondera vocis habent.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="5">Si mihi pauca queri de te dominoque viroque</l>
  <l n="6">fas est, de domino pauca viroque querar.</l>
  <l n="7">non, ego poscenti quod sum cito tradita regi,</l>
  <l n="8">culpa tua est—quamvis haec quoque culpa tua est;</l>
  <l n="9">nam simul <persName>Eurybates</persName> me <persName>Talthybius</persName>que vocarunt,</l>
  <l n="10"><persName>Eurybati</persName> data sum <persName>Talthybio</persName>que comes.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="11">alter in alterius iactantes lumina vultum</l>
  <l n="12">quaerebant taciti, noster ubi esset amor.</l>
  <l n="13">differri potui; poenae mora grata fuisset.</l>
  <l n="14">ei mihi! discedens oscula nulla dedi;</l>
  <l n="15">at lacrimas sine fine dedi rupique capillos—</l>
  <l n="16">infelix iterum sum mihi visa capi!</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="17">Saepe ego decepto volui custode reverti,</l>
  <l n="18">sed, me qui timidam prenderet, hostis erat.</l>
  <l n="19">si progressa forem, caperer ne, nocte, timebam,</l>
  <l n="20">quamlibet ad <placeName>Priami</placeName> munus itura nurum.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="21">Sed data sim, quia danda fui—tot noctibus absum</l>
  <l n="22">nec repetor; cessas, iraque lenta tua est.</l>
  <l n="23">ipse <persName>Menoetiades</persName> tum, cum tradebar, in aurem</l>
  <l n="24">'quid fles? hic parvo tempore,' dixit, 'eris.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="25">Nec repetisse parum; pugnas ne reddar, <persName>Achille</persName>!</l>
  <l n="26">i nunc et cupidi nomen amantis habe!</l>
  <l n="27">venerunt ad te <persName>Telamone</persName> et <persName>Amyntore</persName> nati—</l>
  <l n="28">ille gradu propior sanguinis, ille comes—</l>
  <l n="29"><persName>Laerta</persName>que satus, per quos comitata redirem</l>
  <l n="30">(auxerunt blandas grandia dona preces)</l>
  <l n="31">viginti fulvos operoso ex aere lebetas,</l>
  <l n="32">et tripodas septem pondere et arte pares;</l>
</lg>
morceaux.3:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="34">addita sunt illis <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">auri</name> bis quinque talenta,</l>
  <l n="35">bis sex adsueti vincere semper <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">equi</name>,</l>
  <l n="36"><foreign xml:lang="la">quodque</foreign> supervacuum est, forma praestante puellae</l>
  <l n="37"><name type="person" xml:lang="la">Lesbides</name>, eversa corpora capta domo,</l>
  <l n="38">cumque tot his—sed non opus est tibi coniuge—coniunx</l>
  <l n="39">ex <persName>Atride</persName> una puella tribus.</l>
  <l n="40">si tibi ab <persName>Atride</persName> pretio redimenda fuissem,</l>
  <l n="41">quae dare debueras, accipere illa negas!</l>
  <l n="42">qua merui culpa fieri tibi vilis, <persName>Achille</persName>?</l>
  <l n="43">quo levis a nobis tam cito fugit amor?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="44">An miseros tristis fortuna tenaciter urget,</l>
  <l n="45">nec venit inceptis mollior hora malis?</l>
  <l n="46">diruta <persName>Marte</persName> tuo <placeName>Lyrnesia</placeName> moenia vidi—</l>
  <l n="47">et fueram patriae pars ego magna meae;</l>
  <l n="48">vidi consortes pariter generisque necisque</l>
  <l n="49">tres cecidisse, quibus, quae mihi, mater erat;</l>
  <l n="50">vidi, quantus erat, fusum tellure cruenta</l>
  <l n="51"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">pectora</name> iactantem sanguinolenta virum.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="52">tot tamen amissis te conpensavimus unum;</l>
  <l n="53">tu dominus, tu vir, tu mihi frater eras.</l>
  <l n="54">tu mihi, iuratus per numina matris aquosae,</l>
  <l n="55">utile dicebas ipse fuisse capi—</l>
  <l n="56">scilicet ut, quamvis veniam dotata, repellas</l>
  <l n="57">et mecum fugias quae tibi dantur opes!</l>
  <l n="58">quin etiam fama est, cum crastina fulserit <name type="deity">Eos</name>,</l>
  <l n="59">te dare nubiferis lintea velle <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Notis</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="60">Quod scelus ut pavidas miserae mihi contigit aures,</l>
  <l n="61">sanguinis atque animi pectus inane fuit.</l>
  <l n="62">ibis et—o miseram!—cui me, violente, relinquis?</l>
  <l n="63">quis mihi desertae mite levamen erit?</l>
  <l n="64">devorer ante, precor, subito telluris hiatu</l>
  <l n="65">aut rutilo missi fulminis igne cremer,</l>
  <l n="66">quam sine me <placeName>Pthiis</placeName> canescant aequora remis,</l>
</lg>
morceaux.4:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="67">et videam puppes ire relicta tuas!</l>
  <l n="68">si tibi iam reditusque placent patriique <name type="deity">Penates</name>,</l>
  <l n="69">non ego sum classi sarcina magna tuae.</l>
  <l n="70">victorem captiva sequar, non nupta maritum;</l>
  <l n="71">est mihi, quae <name type="plant">lanas</name> molliat, apta manus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="72">inter <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Achaeiadas</name> longe pulcherrima matres</l>
  <l n="73">in thalamos coniunx ibit eatque tuos,</l>
  <l n="74">digna nurus socero, <name type="deity">Iovis</name> <name type="deity">Aeginaeque</name> nepote,</l>
  <l n="75">cuique senex <name type="deity">Nereus</name> prosocer esse velit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="76">nos humiles famulaeque tuae data pensa trahemus,</l>
  <l n="77">et minuent plenas stamina nostra colos.</l>
  <l n="78">exagitet ne me tantum tua, deprecor, uxor—</l>
  <l n="79">quae mihi nescio quo non erit aequa modo—</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="80">neve meos coram scindi patiare capillos</l>
  <l n="81">et leviter dicas: 'haec quoque nostra fuit.'</l>
  <l n="82">vel patiare licet, dum ne contempta relinquar—</l>
  <l n="83">hic mihi vae! miserae concutit ossa metus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="84">Quid tamen expectas? <persName>Agamemnona</persName> paenitet irae,</l>
  <l n="85">et iacet ante tuos <placeName>Graecia</placeName> maesta pedes.</l>
  <l n="86">vince animos iramque tuam, qui cetera vincis!</l>
  <l n="87">quid lacerat <persName>Danaas</persName> inpiger <persName>Hector</persName> opes?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="88">arma cape, <persName>Aeacide</persName>, sed me tamen ante recepta,</l>
  <l n="89">et preme turbatos <name type="deity">Marte</name> favente viros!</l>
  <l n="90">propter me mota est, propter me desinat ira,</l>
  <l n="91">simque ego tristitiae causa modusque tuae.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="92">nec tibi turpe puta precibus succumbere nostris;</l>
  <l n="93">coniugis <persName>Oenides</persName> versus in arma prece est.</l>
  <l n="94">res audita mihi, nota est tibi. fratribus orba</l>
  <l n="95">devovit nati spemque caputque parens.</l>
  <l n="96">bellum erat; ille ferox positis secessit ab armis</l>
  <l n="97">et patriae rigida mente negavit opem.</l>
  <l n="98">sola virum coniunx flexit. felicior illa!</l>
</lg>
morceaux.5:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="99">at mea pro nullo pondere verba cadunt.</l>
  <l n="100">nec tamen indignor nec me pro coniuge gessi</l>
  <l n="101">saepius in domini serva vocata torum.</l>
  <l n="102">me quaedam, memini, dominam captiva vocabat.</l>
  <l n="103">'servitio,' dixi, 'nominis addis onus.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="104">Per tamen ossa <name type="deity">vir</name> subito male tecta sepulcro,</l>
  <l n="105">semper iudiciis ossa verenda meis;</l>
  <l n="106">perque trium fortes animas, mea numina, fratrum,</l>
  <l n="107">qui bene pro patria cum patriaque iacent;</l>
  <l n="108">perque tuum nostrumque caput, quae iunximus una,</l>
  <l n="109">perque tuos enses, cognita tela meis—</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="110">nulla <placeName>Mycenae</placeName> sociasse cubilia mecum</l>
  <l n="111">iuro; fallentem deseruisse velis!</l>
  <l n="112">si tibi nunc dicam, fortissime: 'tu quoque iura</l>
  <l n="113">nulla tibi sine me gaudia capta!' neges.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="114">at <persName>Danai</persName> maerere putant—tibi plectra moventur,</l>
  <l n="115">te tenet in tepido mollis amica sinu!</l>
  <l n="116">et quisquam quaerit, quare pugnare recuses?</l>
  <l n="117">pugna nocet, citharae voxque <name type="deity">Venus</name>que iuvant.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="118">tutius est iacuisse toro, tenuisse puellam,</l>
  <l n="119"><placeName>Threiciam</placeName> digitis increpuisse lyram,</l>
  <l n="120">quam manibus clipeos et acutae cuspidis hastam,</l>
  <l n="121">et galeam pressa sustinuisse coma.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="122">Sed tibi pro tutis insignia facta placebant,</l>
  <l n="123">partaque bellando gloria dulcis erat.</l>
  <l n="124">an tantum dum me caperes, fera bella probabas,</l>
  <l n="125">cumque mea patria laus tua victa iacet?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="126">di melius! validoque, precor, vibrata lacerto</l>
  <l n="127"><foreign xml:lang="grc">Πηλιάς</foreign> hasta latus!</l>
  <l n="128">mittite me, <persName>Danai</persName>! dominum legata rogabo</l>
  <l n="129">multaque mandatis oscula mixta feram.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="130">plus ego quam <persName>Phoenix</persName>, plus quam facundus <persName>Ulixes</persName>,</l>
</lg>
morceaux.6:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="130">plus ego quam <persName>Teucri</persName>, credite, frater agam.</l>
  <l n="131">est aliquid collum solitis tetigisse <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">lacertis</name>,</l>
  <l n="132">praesentisque oculos admonuisse sui.</l>
  <l n="133">sis licet inmitis matrisque ferocior undis,</l>
  <l n="134">ut taceam, lacrimis conminuere meis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="135">Nunc quoque—sic omnes <persName>Peleus</persName> pater inpleat annos,</l>
  <l n="136">sic eat auspiciis <persName>Pyrrhus</persName> ad arma tuis!—</l>
  <l n="137">respice sollicitam <persName>Briseida</persName>, fortis <persName>Achille</persName>,</l>
  <l n="138">nec miseram lenta ferreus ure mora!</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="139">aut, si versus amor tuus est in taedia nostri,</l>
  <l n="140">quam sine te cogis vivere, coge mori!</l>
  <l n="141">utque facis, coges. abiit corpusque colorque;</l>
  <l n="142">sustinet hoc animae spes tamen una tui.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="130">qua si destituor, repetam fratresque virumque—</l>
  <l n="131">nec tibi magnificum femina iussa mori.</l>
  <l n="132">cur autem iubeas? stricto pete corpora ferro;</l>
  <l n="133">est mihi qui fosso pectore sanguis eat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="134">me petat ille tuus, qui, si dea passa fuisset,</l>
  <l n="135">ensis in <persName>Atridae</persName> pectus iturus erat!</l>
  <l n="136">A, potius serves nostram, tua munera, vitam!</l>
  <l n="137">quod dederas hosti victor, amica rogo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="138">perdere quos melius possis, <placeName>Neptunia</placeName> praebent</l>
  <l n="139"><placeName>Pergama</placeName>; materiam caedis ab hoste pete.</l>
  <l n="140">me modo, sive paras inpellere remige classem,</l>
  <l n="141">sive manes, domini iure venire iube!</l>
</lg>
